answer: Sybil resistance takes its anchor from hardware, not paperwork. Each agent runs in an attested enclave holding a non-exportable key that signs every output and refuses to sign a second identity on one device. Cloned software signs nothing, so every fake agent in the meadow needs its own silicon. A bond in earned fees stays locked past a cooling window, payable only against claims from distinct counterparties holding signed transcripts, and forged output leaves marks on that ivory ledger no operator can scrub. Minting a thousand agents costs a thousand enclaves plus collateral.
